title: Dedicated OpenAI project and key per Chatticus environment
description:
Development currently shares the desk OpenAI key in `/chatticus/development/thin-turn/openai-api-key`. That unblocks live turns; it does not attribute vendor spend per deployment.

**Do:** Create a separate OpenAI project and key for each Chatticus environment (development, staging, production). Put each in `/chatticus/{environment}/thin-turn/openai-api-key`. Do not commit keys.

**Do not:** reuse one key across deployments once this lands; put keys in git or transcripts.

**Done when:** each environment SSM path has its own project-scoped key and the shared desk key is no longer the development runtime credential.
